title: Creamy Garlic Herb Pasta
description: Quick weeknight pasta tossed in a garlicky herb butter sauce with parmesan and fresh parsley.
instructions:
1. Boil salted water and cook pasta until al dente.
2. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and saute minced garlic for 1 minute.
3. Stir in heavy cream and simmer 3 minutes.
4. Toss cooked pasta with sauce, grated parmesan cheese, and chopped herbs.

title: Roasted Chickpea & Aubergine Curry
description: Warming spiced curry with roasted eggplant, chickpeas, and creamy yogurt finish.
instructions:
1. Toss diced eggplant with olive oil and roast at 200C for 20 minutes.
2. Simmer tomatoes, garlic, ginger, and curry spices in a pot.
3. Fold in garbanzo beans and roasted eggplant for 10 minutes.
4. Swirl in greek yogurt off heat and garnish with scallions.

title: Honey Oat Breakfast Pancakes
description: Fluffy weekend pancakes sweetened lightly with wildflower honey and milk.
instructions:
1. Whisk all-purpose flour, bicarbonate of soda, and a pinch of salt.
2. Beat eggs, whole milk, melted butter, and honey in a separate bowl.
3. Combine wet and dry ingredients gently.
4. Cook on a greased skillet until golden on both sides.

title: Crispy Sesame Tofu Stir-Fry
description: Fast skillet stir-fry with seared extra-firm tofu, soy glaze, and peanut-free aromatics.
instructions:
1. Press and cube firm tofu, then sear in peanut oil until crisp.
2. Add vegetables and toss over high heat.
3. Pour in soy sauce and drizzle tahini-garlic dressing.
4. Top with sliced green onions.

title: Crispy Panko Garlic Shrimp
description: Oven-baked garlic shrimp coated in golden panko breadcrumbs and butter.
instructions:
1. Toss peeled shrimp with melted butter and minced garlic.
2. Coat evenly in panko breadcrumbs.
3. Bake at 210C for 10 minutes until golden and crisp.

title: Peanut Noodle Salad Bowl
description: Chilled noodle bowl tossed in a savory peanut butter and soy dressing.
instructions:
1. Cook pasta and rinse under cold water.
2. Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, and warm water into a smooth sauce.
3. Toss noodles with crisp veggies and dressing.

title: Homestyle Vegetable & Bean Soup
description: Comforting simmered soup with chickpeas, beef broth base, and herbs.
instructions:
1. Saute aromatics in olive oil.
2. Pour in beef broth and chickpeas; simmer 20 minutes.
3. Season and serve warm.

title: Classic Vanilla Pudding Cup
description: Silky chilled dessert set with gelatin and sweetened with caster sugar.
instructions:
1. Bloom unflavored gelatin in cold water.
2. Warm whole milk and caster sugar until dissolved.
3. Stir in gelatin, chill 3 hours until set.
